limitations: Review verifies controls and cached exact bytes, not current live provider availability or future download success.
RESECT has no byte-range resume; complete files are reused, previous partial bodies preserved.
Hard-killed/unclosed attempt remains preserved and causes an explicit refusal on restart; ordinary interruption writes its outcome. No fabricated completion is inferred.
No anatomical, registration, negative-annotation-domain, training or planning admission follows from download-only success.
Retry/cooldown interruption and source-integrity errors can leave unresolved files; complete download success is not promised.
